draft.briefing: Hey, you're near Karunagappally! The coast here at Vellanathuruthu is on the Chavara stretch, known worldwide for its black sand packed with minerals like ilmenite, zircon and rutile.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have a named place to eat around here, but the H&J Mall in Karunagappally town has a dining area.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The old Kothukumukku railway bridge is about a 12 min walk, and the H&J Mall is a short drive into town.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk out to the Kothukumukku railway bridge over the Kannetty backwater. It's a local favourite now that the trains are gone.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Migratory shorebirds, including the endangered Great Knot, stop at Vellanathuruthu on their seasonal visits.

tips.title: Bring binoculars.
tips.body: Vellanathuruthu is a bird hotspot, especially when migratory shorebirds pass through.

tips.title: Keep back from the beach edge.
tips.body: High waves and mining have caused dents and caving in the shoreline here.

story.title: A mineral railway
story.body: The Karunagappally to KMML Chavara railway line once crossed the Kannetty backwater on the Kothukumukku bridge.

story.title: A bridge for walkers
story.body: The line closed, and the disused bridge became a local tourist attraction.

story.title: A mall in town
story.body: Actor Mammootty opened the H&J Mall in Karunagappally on 29 March 2015.

story.title: Your turn
story.body: Black sand, birds and a bridge to nowhere. Tell me what you spotted.
